observations: Photo 0: Xbox One console (original 'fat' boxy shape, not S/X) shown side-on, held by a hand, no cables or power adapter visible, no games visible.
Photo 1: Same console with a black Xbox One wireless controller resting on top, held by hand; still no power brick, cables, or game discs/cases visible.
No power-on, screen, or console serial/model plate visible in either photo.
No games (discs or cases) are visible in either photo despite the claim of 6 games including FC.

identity.kind: Xbox One console with one controller

claims.evidence: photo 1 shows one controller resting on the console
No discs, cases, or game library screen shown in either photo
Seller states this but no power adapter is shown at all, so the nature/severity of the fault cannot be seen

risks.risk: Power adapter condition/functionality is unknown and seller admits a fault; Xbox One cannot run without its specific external power brick
risks.proof: Photo or video of the actual power adapter plugged in and the console powering on to the dashboard
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional / console cannot be confirmed to power on

risks.risk: Claimed 6 games including FC not shown
risks.proof: Photo of the physical discs/cases or a screenshot of the installed games list on the dashboard
risks.if_unproven: priced as console-only, no games included

risks.proof: Short video showing the controller connected and responsive in the dashboard menu

risks.risk: No HDMI cable or other accessories shown
risks.proof: Photo of full accessory set laid out (HDMI, adapter, controller)
risks.if_unproven: priced as console + controller only, no extra accessories

risks.risk: General internal condition (disc drive, overheating, hard drive) cannot be assessed from exterior photos
risks.proof: Video of console running a game from disc drive without errors

proof_requests: Photo/video of the actual power adapter and a clip of the console powering on using it
Photo of the 6 game discs/cases or dashboard screenshot showing installed games
Short video of the controller connected and working in a game or dashboard
Photo of any HDMI cable or other accessories included in the sale
response.reason: Item is clearly an Xbox One console with one controller, but the seller-admitted adapter fault (power brick not even shown) and unverified games mean it must be priced at worst case as a bare, non-confirmed-working console with a single controller.
